fx_source_and_orientation.source: official ECB reference-rate histories, same source/orientation convention as frozen PR #122
fx_source_and_orientation.local_currency_price: USD per one unit of local currency; positive log return means local FX strength versus USD

causal_timing.rates_confirmation_time: next monthly as-of t+1 after the confirmed relative-2Y move is observable
causal_timing.fx_entry: first common official ECB fixing strictly after rates_confirmation_time
causal_timing.fx_exit: first common official ECB fixing strictly after the following monthly day-10 as-of date

interpretation_policy.pass: Historical conditional FX candidate only. Because the mechanism was selected on the same historical research environment, PASS requires future unseen confirmation before any edge certification or production use.
interpretation_policy.fail: Do not rescue by changing horizon, event definition, currency set, confirmation rule, direction, threshold, or FX source.
